productionReadiness.record: Standard — Application and Service Production Readiness

deploymentApplicability.justification: GLAZE UI V1.6 is a source-distributed shared presentation/runtime library. It does not operate an independently deployed service, backend, database, container, network endpoint, or persistent production runtime owned by this repository. Creating a fictitious service deployment solely to satisfy an application/service-oriented gate would misstate the actual release boundary.

productionAcceptanceApplicability.justification: For the shared library itself, the applicable production/release acceptance boundary is the immutable Stable publication and its exact distributable source/runtime artifacts. Downstream applications and services must separately validate their own deployment and production acceptance.

requiredStablePublicationBoundary: Exact Stable source revision and release tree.
Immutable Stable version and controlled release identifier/tag.
Supported source/runtime artifact set for the shared library.
Artifact or source-archive SHA-256 checksum evidence.
SBOM covering the applicable released dependency and build boundary.
Final Stable security acceptance for the exact candidate.
Build/release workflow identity and provenance evidence.
Signing or attestation evidence when required by the final release workflow.
Stable acceptance record and release notes tied to the exact release.
Post-publication readback verifying the immutable tag/release/artifact identity.
downstreamBoundary: No GoreeCloud application, service, website, device client, or other consumer inherits deployment acceptance, production acceptance, or V1.6 conformance from the shared Glaze UI release. Each consumer retains repository-local and target-environment acceptance obligations.
boundary: This record resolves only whether an independent service-style deployment is applicable to GLAZE UI V1.6. It establishes that direct deployment is not applicable to the shared library and that immutable publication/artifact acceptance is the applicable Stable release boundary. The final artifact/provenance/publication blocker remains open until that exact release evidence exists.
